use: Illustrative task-specific diagnostic guards, not deployment requirements or an automatic winner.

bilingual.objective: Preserve task agreement when the state language changes; compare instruction wording separately.
bilingual.repeat_rule: Report paired decision flips and accuracy variation separately. Do not equate repeated agreement with truth.

moderation.objective: Expose missed labels and false alarms separately for each assessed category.
moderation.acceptance: Do not call a threshold change an unconditional improvement if either false positives or false negatives rise.
moderation.reference_gate: Unknown labels must not be negatives; original input identity and task taxonomy need review before deployment conclusions.

pairwise.objective: Assess reference-relative choices and sensitivity to displayed document order.
pairwise.scope: These are author-defined comparison labels, not forecasts, financial advice, or validated tournament rankings.
